# 维护者恢复题库数据

这是源码交接说明。学生正常安装、检查更新不需要执行这些步骤：三个完整安装包已内含同批核心与题库。

发行仓库以旧冻结源码、补丁和18 MB源覆盖包重建学习代码；临时传输分支里的985个题库分卷不能成为默认main的祖先。题库的完整学生数据另外保存在本批已签名核心中，移除传输分支不会删除发行数据。

在独立恢复目录下载本批 `kaixin-core-20261117-k12-1.tar.gz`，必须核对：558,930,854字节，SHA256 `4a98fe6512b6f626f318b8e5546b00ef010c5191191da1f2496cfc9b68835965`。原件来自本批GitHub Release；候选未正式验收前不能将它标作正式版。

归档内前缀为 `core/deeptutor/services/student_learning/question_bank_data/`。只向独立目录解出这一路径，随后用于重建源码的数据目录；不要覆盖学生的应用数据。其 `manifest.json` SHA256必须为 `6743986468d69c720dfb5b59bb2ab07c69d515243406db86ebacfaef35643606`，`index.sqlite3` SHA256必须为 `27da57860d26e297582159edecb4a460ca8658ac167c0a425ff6f0cbe58b9a31`。完整逐文件摘要在同批 `core-file-manifest.json`。

题库revision为 `26065ed727a40eab0e29711fd52c00233848e5cd2dd0baabd7f20fff2700c4ee`。数据物理含20,862条资料单元；源码中的精确ID/图片SHA隔离规则仍须保留，实际入口20,846条，其中18,891条结构练习候选。不能通过删隔离规则恢复计数。

原始交接及教师答案证据另留本机私有暂存，不在学生包。417条知识材料也独立暂存，不伪装为练习。恢复本批学生数据无需再解析原PDF/Word或调用模型。新发行仍需重新冻结清单并完成相应验收，不能凭恢复文件覆盖已发布资产。

开心动力超级学霸 · 安装与更新说明（2026-11-17）
目标批次：student-20261117-k12-7
是否已正式提供，以同批 PUBLICATION-RECEIPT 与 GitHub Latest 一致为准。不要只看 v1.7.1，Mac请在屏幕顶部“开心动力超级学霸 → 关于 开心动力超级学霸”查看完整构建编号；Windows查看软件“关于”。

已有软件：正常使用“检查更新”

1. 进入“设置 → 关于 → 检查更新”，或顶部“核心 → 检查更新”。
2. 发现新版后点击“下载并更新”。本批核心 837,565,146 字节（约799 MiB），包含理科原生题页；更新窗口显示实际下载进度与大小。
3. 保持电脑开启。出现“重新打开完成更新”时，先结束正在进行的学习或通话，再点此按钮。
4. 重开后查看完整构建应包含 20261117-k12-7；再次检查更新，应显示已是最新版本。
5. 更新保留原聊天、设置、Key、教材和阅读记录，不需要卸载或删除学习目录。核心、启动器与原生环境分开核对；只关闭窗口不等于完全退出。
6. 缺少兼容运行环境的早期安装可能自动选择约2GB的完整环境更新；不能把新题页自身的295MB当作整个核心包大小。
7. 本批保留断流连接重建与备用通道，并修复信号结束的后台进程被重复等待、可能卡住退出的情况。仍在运行的后台必须真正退出，不能用超时跳过。旧更新器必须先成功取得一次更新，才能获得新恢复逻辑。持续断网、系统终止或磁盘错误仍可能失败；失败时保留完整日志，不清理学习数据。
8. 如在线反复失败，U盘同批02对应系统提供完整环境离线更新。正常升级仍统一使用“检查更新”，不串装旧补丁、不运行旧00匹配脚本、不修改环境编号。

第一次安装：从同一版本页面下载整套文件

Windows 64位：以下五份必须同一文件夹。
Kaixin-Super-Scholar-Windows-v1.7.1-Setup.exe
Kaixin-Super-Scholar-Windows-v1.7.1-Runtime.001
Kaixin-Super-Scholar-Windows-v1.7.1-Runtime.002
Kaixin-Super-Scholar-Windows-v1.7.1-Runtime.003
Kaixin-Super-Scholar-Windows-v1.7.1-Runtime.004
双击Setup.exe。若使用完整ZIP，先“全部解压”再运行；不要在ZIP里启动，不要单独解压Runtime。Windows文件名固定，禁止混用不同批次的Setup和Runtime。

Intel Mac（本批共五个分卷）：
Kaixin-Super-Scholar-MacOS-Intel-v1.7.1-20261117-k12-7-part.dmg
Kaixin-Super-Scholar-MacOS-Intel-v1.7.1-20261117-k12-7-part.002.dmgpart

Apple芯片Mac（本批共四个分卷）：

Kaixin-Super-Scholar-MacOS-Apple-Silicon-v1.7.1-20261117-k12-7-part.002.dmgpart

对应系统的所有分卷下载完成后放在同一文件夹，打开主镜像-part.dmg，将软件拖进“应用程序”，再从应用程序启动。不要逐个打开.dmgpart，不混用Intel与Apple芯片分卷。两种Mac均要求macOS13或以上。
U盘里的Mac包另行合成为普通单文件DMG，按盘上说明直接打开即可，不需要再找GitHub分卷。是否完成U盘替换，以同批USB-DELIVERY-RECEIPT为准。
建议先空出40GB安装临时空间；本批三份首次安装文件已包含当前核心，不需要先装旧版再串装补丁。

查看版本与失败退路

只有v1.7.1和日期不足以判断是否需要迁移。关于弹窗中完整构建包含20261117-k12-7时，本轮无需再安装离线包；更高版本或未知候选不强行降级。
旧正式版先检查更新，失败再用同批02；更早或未知底座未逐台实测，遇到签名或不兼容错误应停止、保留日志，不改编号。
软件打不开或没有“安装核心更新”菜单时，完全退出后用对应系统整合完整版原位覆盖程序，保留原学习目录；不要先卸载清数据。
下载需要能访问GitHub发布资源，不需要GitHub Token；速度取决于网络。U盘离线更新不需要重新下载包，学习时调用在线模型仍需联网。

本批功能与验收范围

新增698份理科原生题页PDF，共3888页，绑定6915条理科题源记录；这是原稿整页/单元，不等于6915张精准单题裁图。含图和公式保留原排版，支持原题预览、放大和页码跳转；正文先显示，题页异步加载。
既有294条预制整题图和其他题源保留；17条已有异常隔离维持。20,845条是物理可读题源单位数，不能解释为所有题目或答案都已独立学术审核。
本批不调整模型提示、老师规则、完整题干、历史上下文或输出预算；原生显示验收不冒充所有模型或所有实体学生电脑均已测试。
维护识别：源fbb301fd21cf2169f834e0b548d56d201cc98365；启动器20261118-updater-4。具体三端验收、正式更新和本机更新结果看同批回执。

# 图片题怎么用

目标版本：`student-20261117-k12-2`  
状态：本次版本的 Windows x64、Intel Mac、Apple 芯片 Mac 原生新装、当前与旧启动器检查更新验收均已通过；正式状态以最新 Release 和发布回执为准。

当本轮实际采用了本批已准备的题库原题，聊天中会显示一张完整题目图。它把题干、公式、必要图示和 A–D 选项放在一起，方便直接做题；点击图片可打开完整题源，并使用放大查看。旁边的淡蓝来源标注也能回到对应原题。保存的聊天重新打开后，题目图与来源仍可查看，前提是当前账号仍有该资料的访问权限。

本批覆盖 **294 道题、26 份题源、82 个不同原图**。这些图片在交付前已生成并核对，学生使用时不需要现场截图，也不会把这张展示图再额外送进模型。原有模型所需的完整题干与必要原图不删减、不重复追加。

不是每条命中都会贴图：目录里看见的候选、仅相关资料或本轮没有采用的题，不会冒充本轮原题。尚未准备完整题目图的内容，继续使用原有题源预览；图片暂时无法加载时，仍可从来源入口查看原始题干与图示。

## 讲解与出题的区别

- 普通讲解以模型主讲，相关教材页供对照；不能把仅相关页面当成已经采用的答案依据。
- 普通出题先在共用的 1 秒期限内尝试合适题源，目前优先走已验证的纯文字路径；未找到或超时后继续原来的模型出题，不为补一个来源标注反复查找。
- 明确要求“从题库里找”时，优先继续读取可用原题及必要原图。确无合适题目或暂时读取未完成时，简短说明并接替代方案，不编造题源。
- 学生引用的临时资料、阅读中的文章或指定私库，仍按当前资料范围处理；不会因本次题目图展示而扩大到无权访问的材料。

本批没有开放普通可选检索的自动视觉模型切换，也没有把截图展示当成“所有图片题已自动选取”。它首先改善已经完整读取并采用的原题如何呈现。复杂整卷、边界不清或无法证明完整性的候选仍单独处理，不截掉必要条件来凑成一题。

## 验证结果与范围

原 295 道图中有 1 道原题的 6 cm 与 6 m 条件自相矛盾，已精确隔离并保留原件，不猜改。最终 294 道是其余图片、完整题干与选项均保持原字节的不变子集，WebP 与验证 PNG 的解码像素一致。图包自身为 13,579,283 字节，不代表整个更新包大小。两道旧 Word 公式题另做了来源与公式显示核对。数学、物理及语文多图题的抽核证明：加上展示图前后，模型题干和全部原图输入一致，因此截图展示没有增加一轮模型调用。

此前同模型对照累计 9 次请求：7 份完整回答通过题目完整性与可解性核对，2 次受隔离诊断的工具限制中止，未计完整样本，也不能因此判定正式产品失败。最终隔离后没有新增付费调用；本地零联网测试确认未受影响的题干与全部原图输入不变，复用这些历史记录。浮力样本采用题库后没有观察到额外等待；中位数采用题库的两份样本，相对唯一完整基线分别多约 1.44 秒、少约 0.44 秒。数学样本不均衡，不能宣称所有问题平均提速。详细时间见本批发布说明。

# Candidate recipe, 2026-11-16

This directory is an APFS clone of the preview3 release recipe. The previous directory and stable release are unchanged. It is a distribution-repository overlay, not the learning-source checkout. Copy only the files in the candidate recipe commit; inherited evidence is historical evidence.

The current baseline is `student-20261115-preview3`, learning source `896e79b517a008ac6d584526151862ff6191cf77`, release ID `445953276`. `fresh-install-lock.json` now pins that actual baseline's thirteen public installation files. Current and oldest-launcher update paths remain distinct native tests.

`prepare-candidate.py` requires the owner's final source HEAD, explicit isolation ledger and completed student-only bank pack. It hashes the published export, prepares a complete runtime-file manifest and makes immutable 512 KiB source/bank transport parts. Each full part encodes to 699,052 base64 characters, below the measured nested-tool output cap. The source overlay is applied only after the entire previous verified patch chain. It supports only ledger-declared physical deletions from an export checkout; other tracked dirty files fail. It never signs or uploads. Example, after final freeze:

```sh
python prepare-candidate.py --source OWNER_EXPORT --commit OWNER_HEAD --tag student-20261116-k12-ATTEMPT --baseline-source /Users/Admin1/Documents/Kaixin-20261115-聊天快速预览/source --bank /Users/Admin1/Documents/Kaixin-20261115-K12题库工程/bank-runtime-20261116 --bank-manifest-sha 5c661fe9db8f73dd236ed3627849af8de66f2dd9bbcc89181650ec0ac0c5e288 --bank-archive-prefix core/deeptutor/services/student_learning/question_bank_data --isolation-ledger OWNER_LEDGER
```

The bank is generated data inside the existing signed core, at `core/deeptutor/services/student_learning/question_bank_data/{manifest.json,index.sqlite3,student-assets/...}`. It is outside the learning-source Git inventory and inside its own hash-bound generated-payload manifest. The original staging data, teacher answers and private account files are not copied. The final pack's builder/source/staging receipts stay bound by its manifest.

The owner must provide the final signed launcher descriptor with the final core identity. Launcher script bytes remain unchanged if their existing fingerprints still match. `ci-attachment-core.py` builds every declared runtime source file, rebuilds the locked Word helper, adds the generated bank, then reads back every actual archive member and runs the bundle audit. The pending model assets are excluded by path and hash; exclusion cannot be hidden by renaming. A pending semantic-distribution item must stay explicit in the ledger and release notes.

Candidate source can be delivered through the GitHub connector's blobs/tree/commit operations. No local `gh`, copied private plugin token or client-side GitHub token is required. The runner uses its normal short-lived `github.token`. A `codex/k12-recipe-20261116-*` branch is review-only. After complete final inputs, a `codex/k12-core-20261116-*` push creates/uploads an isolated prerelease. Following core readback and local owner signatures, a `codex/k12-native-20261116-*` push runs independent Windows x64, Intel Mac and Apple Silicon Mac jobs. These names do not trigger the copied historical publication workflow.

The owner-selected final tag is `student-20261117-k12-1`; explicit November 16 and 17 candidate branch/tag prefixes are accepted. The final word helper is rebuilt from its locked dependencies and recorded separately, including its actual archive-member SHA/bytes.

`prepare-connector-upload.py` freezes the transport plan only after final inputs exist. `connector-upload-candidate.js` runs inside `functions.exec`, reads bounded 384 KiB chunks, verifies exact length and Git blob SHA, uploads four independent immutable blobs at a time and checkpoints each success. A failed batch stops after preserving its other successes. Resume skips only exact matching checkpointed files. It creates the core-triggering branch only after every planned blob exists. Its mock test covers a failed four-call batch, missing-only resume, multichunk binary identity and a lost branch-creation response followed by readback. No actual bank upload has been performed during recipe preparation.

The temporary payload commit must never be merged into main. Build native and publication metadata branches from the previously verified small main plus recipe/JSON changes. Core CI also uploads one hash-bound source-overlay release asset, allowing `bootstrap_source.py` to reconstruct the frozen public export without Git transport parts. The bootstrap accepts only the fixed repository release URL, trusted redirect hosts, declared byte count and SHA. After candidate assets and native checks are read back, only this batch's temporary transport refs may be cleaned up by the owner; no old release may be deleted. Main and its ZIP must contain source/asset references rather than the hundreds of MiB of transport parts.

This batch introduces 687,525,636 bytes of student-only bank files, compressed to 515,884,654 bytes (about 492 MiB), requiring 984 512 KiB transport blobs. This is the first bank-data delivery cost, not an answer-speed measurement; final core size comes from its archive receipt. The existing updater skips an already-current runtime and reuses an already-installed identical runtime/SHA/signature. It has no per-file bank reuse across a different core archive. Do not promise future code-only bank deduplication without separately implementing/testing the existing-backend data reuse path; no launcher architecture was added here.

Fresh native API checks compare full questions/options/subquestions and images to the installed pack; wrong revisions/unknown identities fail. Actual native update IPC retains existing upload/audio/formula/quick-preview gates and adds four-size source-library/history-link checks. All fixtures use explicitly marked disposable homes, public original questions and synthetic history; no model request is needed. Source/selector contracts must match the final product before the native branch is frozen. API smoke does not replace the existing authorization unit tests or claim all user hardware was tested.

`attachment-release.json` and `attachment-publication.json` remain `prepared: false` until the owner finalizes them. No old proof can satisfy the new promotion guard. The publication helper additionally requires fresh same-revision K12 API and native UI proofs on all three platforms. Only the owner may prepare/run promotion after the full matrix succeeds. Stable manifests, Latest, the installed app and USB were not changed by recipe preparation.

Local checks: Python 3.12 `-B -m unittest -v test_release_source.py test_native_k12_api.py` (13 passing); `node test-connector-upload.cjs`; Python AST and Node syntax checks. The API-smoke fixture uses synthetic localhost replies; the connector test uses only fake tools. These checks do not import product code or contact a model/GitHub. They are not native acceptance results.

"""Verify the approved source snapshot before unpacking it on a disposable runner."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tarfile

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument("--with-updates", action="store_true", help="Apply the latest developer fixes after verifying the installer baseline.")
options = parser.parse_args()
root = Path.cwd()
manifest = json.loads((root / "source-manifest.json").read_text())
destination = root / "student-source"
archive = root / "frozen-source.tar.gz"
digest = hashlib.sha256()
with archive.open("wb") as output:
    for part in manifest["parts"]:
        name = part["file"]
        assert Path(name).name == name and name.startswith("frozen-source.")
        data = (root / name).read_bytes()
        assert len(data) == part["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == part["sha256"]
        digest.update(data)
        output.write(data)
assert digest.hexdigest() == manifest["archiveSHA256"]
destination.mkdir()
with tarfile.open(archive) as package:
    package.extractall(destination, filter="data")
assert not (destination / "data/user").exists()
assert not (destination / "apps/desktop/.local").exists()
(destination / "SOURCE_FREEZE.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2))
for arguments in (["init"], ["config", "user.name", "Kaixin Student Builder"],
                  ["config", "user.email", "build@users.noreply.github.com"],
                  ["add", "--force", "."], ["commit", "-m", "Frozen student source " + manifest["commit"]]):
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(destination), *arguments], check=True)
print("Verified credential-free source snapshot", manifest["commit"])

if options.with_updates:
    updates = [manifest["sourceUpdate"], *manifest.get("additionalSourceUpdates", [])]
    for update in updates:
        patch = root / update["file"]
        if hashlib.sha256(patch.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != update["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Student source update checksum mismatch")
        for arguments in (["apply", "--index", str(patch)], ["commit", "-m", update["description"]]):
            subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(destination), *arguments], check=True)
        print("Applied student source update", update["sha256"])


if options.with_updates and manifest.get("sourceOverlay"):
    from release_source import apply_overlay, stage_frozen_files
    overlay = apply_overlay(root, destination, manifest["sourceOverlay"])
    stage_frozen_files(destination, overlay["files"])
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(destination), "commit", "-m", "Frozen release source " + overlay["source_commit"]], check=True)
    print("Verified final owner-frozen source", overlay["source_commit"])

    digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

"""Reverify exact existing Intel installers; never package, sign, or replace an asset."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

REPO = '1281504089-cell/kaixin-k12-tutor'
TARGET = 'macos-x64'

def sha(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()

def run(argv, **kwargs):
    return subprocess.run([str(x) for x in argv], check=True, **kwargs)

def gh(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['gh', *map(str, args)])

def api(path):
    return json.loads(gh('api', 'repos/' + REPO + '/' + path))

def validate_lock(lock, frozen_raw):
    assert lock['target'] == TARGET and lock['candidate_tag'] == 'student-20261117-k12-1'
    assert lock['candidate_release_id'] == 447366728 and lock['baseline_latest_id'] == 445953276
    assert lock['source_commit'] == '5ff65526b0665ae844d865ef21a88eaebbf63da2'
    assert lock['original_native_run'] == 43922470199
    assert len(lock['candidate_files']) == 4
    assert len({r['id'] for r in lock['candidate_files']}) == 4
    for row in lock['candidate_files']:
        assert Path(row['name']).name == row['name'] and row['name'].startswith('Kaixin-Super-Scholar-MacOS-Intel-v1.7.1-20261117-k12-1-part')
        assert row['url'] == 'https://github.com/' + REPO + '/releases/download/' + lock['candidate_tag'] + '/' + row['name']
        assert len(row['sha256']) == 64 and row['bytes'] > 0
    assert hashlib.sha256(frozen_raw).hexdigest() == lock['frozen_stage']['sha256']
    assert len(frozen_raw) == lock['frozen_stage']['bytes']
    frozen = json.loads(frozen_raw)
    assert frozen['core_commit'] == lock['source_commit'] and len(frozen['manifests']) == 36
    assert len(lock['signed_runtime_assets']) == 36
    assert lock['prior_manifest']['commit'] != lock['source_commit']
    assert lock['prior_manifest']['archive'] == lock['prior_core_asset']['name']
    assert lock['prior_manifest']['sha256'] == lock['prior_core_asset']['sha256']
    assert lock['prior_manifest']['baseRuntimeId'] == lock['included_manifest']['baseRuntimeId']
    assert lock['included_manifest']['sha256'] == lock['core_asset']['sha256']
    assert frozen['manifests']['runtime-macos-x64.json']['corePayloadSha256'] == lock['core_asset']['sha256']
    assert lock['prior_core_asset']['url'] == 'https://github.com/' + REPO + '/releases/download/' + lock['baseline_latest_tag'] + '/' + lock['prior_core_asset']['name']
    return frozen

def verify_metadata(lock):
    assert api('releases/latest')['id'] == lock['baseline_latest_id'], 'Latest changed during Intel revalidation'
    release = api('releases/tags/' + lock['candidate_tag'])
    assert release['id'] == lock['candidate_release_id'] and release['prerelease'] and not release['draft']
    assets = {a['name']: a for a in release['assets']}
    expected = [*lock['candidate_files'], lock['core_asset'],
                dict(name=lock['bridge']['name'], id=lock['bridge']['asset_id'], bytes=lock['bridge']['bytes'], sha256=lock['bridge']['sha256']),
                *lock['signed_runtime_assets']]
    for row in expected:
        actual = assets[row['name']]
        assert actual['id'] == row['id'] and actual['size'] == row['bytes'] and actual['digest'] == 'sha256:' + row['sha256'], row['name']
    stable = {a['name']:a for a in api('releases/tags/core-updates')['assets']}
    for name,digest in lock['baseline_feeds'].items():assert stable[name]['digest'] == 'sha256:' + digest, 'Stable feed changed: ' + name
    return release

def download(row, directory):
    file = directory / row['name']
    errors = []
    routes = [row['url'], 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + REPO + '/releases/assets/' + str(row['id']) + '?readback=' + str(time.time_ns())]
    for url in routes:
        partial = file.with_suffix(file.suffix + '.partial')
        try:
            with urlopen(Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Kaixin-Frozen-Intel-Revalidation','Accept':'application/octet-stream'}), timeout=90) as response, partial.open('xb') as output:
                final_url = urlparse(response.geturl())
                assert final_url.scheme == 'https' and final_url.hostname in {'github.com','api.github.com','release-assets.githubusercontent.com','objects.githubusercontent.com'}
                received = 0
                while chunk := response.read(8 * 1024**2):
                    received += len(chunk)
                    assert received <= row['bytes'], 'Oversized immutable download: ' + row['name']
                    output.write(chunk)
            assert partial.stat().st_size == row['bytes'] and sha(partial) == row['sha256'], row['name']
            partial.rename(file)
            return {**row, 'anonymous_download':True, 'sha256_verified':True}
        except Exception as error:
            partial.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            errors.append(str(error))
    raise RuntimeError('Both anonymous routes failed: ' + row['name'] + ': ' + '; '.join(errors))

def verify_signatures(root, resources, lock):
    key = resources / 'app/assets/runtime-public.pem'
    assert sha(key) == lock['public_key_sha256']
    code = """import{readFile}from'node:fs/promises';import{pathToFileURL}from'node:url';import assert from'node:assert/strict';const{verifyManifest}=await import(pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]));const key=await readFile(process.argv[2]);const lock=JSON.parse(await readFile(process.argv[3]));const f=JSON.parse(await readFile(process.argv[4]));for(const m of [lock.included_manifest,lock.prior_manifest,...Object.values(f.manifests)])verifyManifest(m,key,m.arch,m.platform);console.log('PASS: installed public key verified included/prior/all36 stage manifests');"""
    run(['node','--input-type=module','-e',code,resources/'app/src/bundles.mjs',key,root/'intel-reuse-lock.json',root/'attachment-final-manifests.json'])

def verify_proxy(root, resources, evidence):
    probe = root / 'intel-reuse-network-probe.app'
    shutil.copytree(resources.parent.parent, probe, symlinks=True,
                    ignore=lambda directory,names: [n for n in names if n in {'seed','update'}] if Path(directory)==resources else [])
    qa_home = root / 'intel-reuse-proxy-home'
    qa_home.mkdir()
    try:
        copied = probe / 'Contents/Resources'
        package = copied / 'app/package.json'
        value = json.loads(package.read_text());value['main'] = 'src/proxy-smoke.cjs'
        package.write_text(json.dumps(value))
        shutil.copyfile(root/'ci-proxy-smoke.cjs', copied/'app/src/proxy-smoke.cjs')
        run(['/usr/bin/codesign','--force','--deep','--sign','-',probe])
        run([probe/'Contents/MacOS/开心动力超级学霸'],timeout=300,env={**os.environ,
            'KX_PROXY_HOME':str(qa_home),'KX_BASE_MANIFEST':str(resources/'seed/runtime.json'),
            'KX_PROXY_RESULT':str(evidence/'network.json')})
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(probe)
        shutil.rmtree(qa_home)

def upload_new(tag, path):
    before = api('releases/tags/' + tag)
    assert not any(a['name'] == path.name for a in before['assets']), 'Refuse to overwrite existing evidence: ' + path.name
    error = None
    try:
        gh('release','upload',tag,path)
    except Exception as caught:
        error = caught
    actual = next((a for a in api('releases/tags/' + tag)['assets'] if a['name'] == path.name), None)
    assert actual and actual['digest'] == 'sha256:' + sha(path) and actual['size'] == path.stat().st_size, str(error)

def main():
    root = Path.cwd()
    lock = json.loads((root/'intel-reuse-lock.json').read_text())
    frozen = validate_lock(lock, (root/'attachment-final-manifests.json').read_bytes())
    batch = json.loads((root/'attachment-batch.json').read_text())
    assert batch['manifests'][TARGET] == lock['included_manifest']
    release = verify_metadata(lock)
    evidence = root/'fresh-evidence'/TARGET;evidence.mkdir(parents=True)
    (evidence/'reuse-lock.json').write_bytes((root/'intel-reuse-lock.json').read_bytes())
    run_id = int(os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID']);head = os.environ['GITHUB_SHA']
    marker = evidence/('intel-reverify-run-' + str(run_id) + '.json')
    marker.write_text(json.dumps(dict(run_id=run_id,workflow_commit=head,source_commit=lock['source_commit'],original_failed_run=lock['original_native_run'],candidate_reuse=True)))
    upload_new(lock['candidate_tag'],marker)
    work = root/'intel-reuse-work';work.mkdir()
    downloads = work/'downloads';downloads.mkdir()
    receipts = [download(row,downloads) for row in lock['candidate_files']]
    (evidence/'downloads.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipts,indent=2))
    install = work/'installed';install.mkdir()
    mount = work/'mount';mount.mkdir()
    image = next(downloads.glob('*-part.dmg'))
    run(['/usr/bin/hdiutil','verify',image],timeout=300)
    attached = False
    try:
        run(['/usr/bin/hdiutil','attach','-readonly','-nobrowse','-noautoopen','-mountpoint',mount,image],timeout=300)
        attached = True
        app = install/'开心动力超级学霸.app'
        run(['/usr/bin/ditto',mount/app.name,app])
    finally:
        detached = subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/hdiutil','detach',str(mount)],capture_output=True)
        if attached:assert detached.returncode == 0, detached.stderr.decode(errors='replace')
    run(['/usr/bin/codesign','--verify','--deep','--strict',app])
    resources = app/'Contents/Resources'
    included = json.loads((resources/'update/runtime.json').read_text())
    assert included == lock['included_manifest']
    assert json.loads((resources/'seed/runtime.json').read_text())['runtimeId'] == included['baseRuntimeId']
    included_core = resources/'update'/included['archive']
    assert included_core.stat().st_size == lock['core_asset']['bytes'] and sha(included_core) == lock['core_asset']['sha256']
    for name,row in batch['shell_files'].items():assert sha(resources/'app'/name) == row['sha256']
    verify_signatures(root,resources,lock)
    shutil.rmtree(downloads)
    prior = root/'prior-update';prior.mkdir()
    download(lock['prior_core_asset'],prior)
    (prior/'runtime.json').write_text(json.dumps(lock['prior_manifest'],indent=2))
    verify_proxy(root,resources,evidence)
    environment = {**os.environ,'KX_EXPECTED_PLATFORM':'darwin','KX_EXPECTED_ARCH':'x64'}
    home = work/'全新学习目录'
    run(['node','ci-fresh-smoke.mjs',app/'Contents/MacOS/开心动力超级学霸',resources,home,evidence],env=environment,timeout=1100)
    from ci_update_probe import verify_update_entry
    oldest = verify_update_entry(root,TARGET,install,resources,home,evidence,legacy=True)
    current = verify_update_entry(root,TARGET,install,resources,home,evidence)
    verify_metadata(lock)
    report = dict(target=TARGET,input_release=lock['candidate_tag'],input_release_id=release['id'],release=batch['tag'],
        launcher_build=batch['launcher_build'],core_commit=lock['source_commit'],downloaded_from_public_github=True,
        download_files=receipts,native_install='passed',native_smoke=json.loads((evidence/'app.json').read_text()),
        network=json.loads((evidence/'network.json').read_text()),update_entry=current,oldest_launcher_entry=oldest,
        launcher_migration={'from_published_launcher':'oldest-launcher-src frozen on original candidate branch','signed_core_carrier':oldest['signed_launcher_restarted']},
        shell_files=batch['shell_files'],full_files=[dict(file=r['name'],bytes=r['bytes'],sha256=r['sha256']) for r in lock['candidate_files']],
        real_keys_used=False,real_learning_records_modified=False,
        provenance=dict(verification_run=run_id,workflow_commit=head,original_failed_run=lock['original_native_run'],original_failed_job=lock['original_failed_job'],
                        original_stage_run=lock['original_native_run'],original_stage_workflow_commit=lock['original_native_workflow_commit'],
                        frozen_stage_sha256=lock['frozen_stage']['sha256'],bridge_rebuilt=False,installers_repackaged=False,
                        existing_assets_overwritten=False,fresh_smoke_rerun=True,proxy_smoke_rerun=True,oldest_and_current_ipc_rerun=True))
    (evidence/'verified.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

"""Re-use the verified native environment and validate the new earliest-client bridge."""
import hashlib,json,os,re,shutil,subprocess,tarfile,time
from pathlib import Path

def sha(file):
 with file.open('rb') as stream:return hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()

def bridge_identity(tag,target):
 assert re.fullmatch(r'student-[0-9]{8}-[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*',tag)
 assert target in {'windows-x64','macos-x64','macos-arm64'}
 slug=tag.removeprefix('student-')
 return 'kaixin-bridge-'+slug+'-'+target+'.tar.gz','1.7.1-kaixin-'+slug+'-'+target+'-universal'

def prepare_bridge(root,target,resources,home,evidence,batch):
 base=json.loads((resources/'seed/runtime.json').read_text())
 native=home/'runtimes'/base['runtimeId'];stage=root/('bridge-native-'+target)
 shutil.copytree(native,stage,symlinks=True,copy_function=os.link)

def validate_native_page_views(ui, fixture):
    assert ui['passed'] is True and ui['actualNativeRenderer'] is True and ui['schema_version'] == 2
    assert ui['bank_revision'] == fixture['bank_revision'] and len(ui['views']) == 4
    for view in ui['views']:
        assert all(view['preparedPicture'][key] is True for key in ('native_http_image_sha_verified', 'body_dom_before_image_response', 'second_history_restore'))
        pages = view['nativePages']
        assert pages['renderer'] == 'native-pages'
        assert pages['response_capture'] == 'Fetch.getResponseBody' and isinstance(pages['original_request_id'],str) and pages['original_request_id']
        assert pages['inline_probe']['ready'] is True and pages['modal_probe']['ready'] is True
        assert pages['qualified_id'] == fixture['qualified_id'] and pages['bank_revision'] == fixture['bank_revision']
        for key in ('sha256', 'bytes', 'page_count', 'start_page', 'end_page'):
            assert pages[key] == fixture['native'][key], key
        assert 1 <= pages['start_page'] <= pages['end_page'] <= pages['page_count']
        assert all(pages[key] is True for key in NATIVE_PAGE_CHECKS)


def validate_native_page_api(api, expected):

def validate_installer_files(files, target, tag):
    names = {row['file'] for row in files}

    if target == 'windows-x64':
        stem = 'Kaixin-Super-Scholar-Windows-v1.7.1-'
        expected = {stem+'Setup.exe', *(stem+'Runtime.00'+str(i) for i in range(1,5))}

        expected = {stem+'.dmg', *(stem+f'.{i:03d}.dmgpart' for i in range(2,len(files)+1))}

def verify_production_launcher(root, target, install, resources, evidence):

    probe = root / ('network-probe-' + target + ('.app' if target.startswith('macos-') else ''))
    source_app = resources.parent.parent if target.startswith('macos-') else install

        assert hashlib.sha256((resources / 'app' / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == row['sha256'], 'Unexpected prior launcher'
    shutil.copytree(resources / 'app/src', root / 'previous-launcher-src')
    shutil.copytree(resources / 'update', root / 'prior-update')
    core = resources / 'update'
    for file in core.iterdir():
        file.unlink()
    asset = batch['core_asset']
    request = Request(asset['browser_download_url'], headers={'User-Agent': 'Kaixin-native-release'})
    archive = core / manifest['archive']
    with urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response, archive.open('xb') as output:

    shutil.rmtree(resources / 'app/src')

            assert len(data) == row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == row['sha256']

    for name, row in batch['shell_files'].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256((resources / 'app' / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == row['sha256']

    pkg = json.loads((resources / 'app/package.json').read_text())

        shutil.rmtree(downloads)

        image = out / (stem + '.dmg')

                        '-fs', 'APFS', '-format', 'ULFO', str(image)], check=True)
        subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/hdiutil', 'verify', str(image)], check=True)
        subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/hdiutil', 'segment', '-segmentSize', '1900m', '-o', str(out / (stem + '-part.dmg')), str(image)], check=True)
        image.unlink()
        shutil.rmtree(app)
        mount = root / ('candidate-mount-' + target)

        setup = out / 'Kaixin-Super-Scholar-Windows-v1.7.1-Setup.exe'

    return out, batch

"""Bounded, hash-checked connector input/output. Never reads credentials."""
import argparse
import base64
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from release_source import safe_name, sha

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument("action", choices=["state", "read", "checkpoint"])
parser.add_argument("--file")
parser.add_argument("--offset", type=int, default=0)
parser.add_argument("--record-base64")
parser.add_argument("--plan", default="CONNECTOR-UPLOAD-PLAN.json", choices=["CONNECTOR-UPLOAD-PLAN.json", "BANK-CONNECTOR-UPLOAD-PLAN.json"])
args = parser.parse_args()
if args.action == "read" and (root / ".bank-upload.pause").exists():
    raise SystemExit("Paused before a new immutable blob request; checkpoints preserved")
plan = json.loads((root / args.plan).read_text())
checkpoint = root / ".connector-checkpoints"
checkpoint.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
if args.action == "state":
    print(json.dumps({"plan": plan, "checkpoint": [json.loads(file.read_text()) for file in checkpoint.glob("*.json")]}))
elif args.action == "read":
    row = next(row for row in plan["files"] if row["file"] == args.file)
    file = root / safe_name(row["file"])
    assert file.stat().st_size == row["bytes"] and sha(file) == row["sha256"]
    assert 0 <= args.offset <= row["bytes"]
    # A complete <=512 KiB part fits the measured output cap. Larger metadata
    # uses 384 KiB chunks divisible by three for safe base64 concatenation.
    length = 512 * 1024 if row["bytes"] <= 512 * 1024 else 384 * 1024
    with file.open("rb") as stream:
        stream.seek(args.offset);data = stream.read(length)
    print(json.dumps({"file": row["file"], "offset": args.offset, "bytes": len(data), "base64": base64.b64encode(data).decode()}))
else:
    record = json.loads(base64.b64decode(args.record_base64, validate=True))
    if "file" in record:
        row = next(row for row in plan["files"] if row["file"] == record["file"])
        assert record["sha256"] == row["sha256"] and record["blob_sha"] == row["git_blob_sha"]
        name = hashlib.sha256(row["file"].encode()).hexdigest() + ".json"
    else:
        assert record["branch"] == plan["branch"] and record["parent_sha"] == plan["parent_sha"]
        name = "FINAL.json"
    destination = checkpoint / name
    temporary = destination.with_suffix(".partial")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    temporary.replace(destination)
    print(json.dumps({"saved": name}))

NATIVE_EXPECTED = {"manifest_sha256": "91631719fe6e228a0b580d469a15943bb5ba80828f5114ea10e731dcd598da0a",
    "records": 6915, "pdfs": 698, "total_bytes": 295359867,
    "samples": {"math:q_e9dd00ffa1178d29b41fadb4_2": "math", "new-five:q_0264cefbf2bc2978e20b01f3_b00012_3": "physics",
        "five-subject:src_04fccdbddbb0696b58cc5678_b00001_full": "biology", "five-subject:q_075b4515a0802954bc5c6a4f": "chemistry"}}


def verify_native_pages(get, core, revision, database, expected):
    root = core / "deeptutor/services/student_learning/question_native_data"
    raw_manifest = (root / "manifest.json").read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw_manifest).hexdigest() == expected["manifest_sha256"]
    manifest = json.loads(raw_manifest)
    assert manifest["bank_revision"] == revision and len(manifest["items"]) == expected["records"]
    files = {item["file"] for item in manifest["items"].values()}
    assert files == {p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in (root / "documents").glob("*.pdf")}
    assert len(files) == expected["pdfs"] and sum((root / name).stat().st_size for name in files) + len(raw_manifest) == expected["total_bytes"]
    checks = []
    for identity, subject in expected["samples"].items():
        item = manifest["items"][identity]
        row = database.execute("SELECT q.payload_sha,d.body_json FROM questions q JOIN documents d USING(payload_sha) WHERE q.qualified_id=?", (identity,)).fetchone()
        assert row and row[0] == item["source_payload_sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(row[1].encode()).hexdigest()
        payload = json.loads(row[1])
        assert payload["subject"] == subject and payload["source_hash"] == item["source_hash"]
        assert [asset["id"] for asset in payload["assets"]] == item["asset_sha256"]
        detail = get("/api/student/question-bank/questions/" + quote(identity, safe="") + "?revision=" + revision)
        url = "/api/student/question-bank/native/" + quote(identity, safe="") + "?revision=" + revision + "&sha256=" + item["sha256"]
        descriptor = {"url": url, **{key: item[key] for key in ("sha256", "bytes", "page_count", "start_page", "end_page", "kind")}}
        assert detail["source"]["native_required"] is True and detail["source"]["native"] == descriptor
        raw, headers = get(url, raw=True, headers=True)
        assert headers["Content-Type"] == "application/pdf" and headers["Cache-Control"] == "private, no-store"
        assert headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] == "nosniff" and headers["Content-Security-Policy"] == "default-src 'none'; sandbox"
        assert len(raw) == item["bytes"] and raw.startswith(b"%PDF-") and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == item["sha256"]
        get(url.replace(revision, "0" * 64), 404)
        get(url.replace(item["sha256"], "0" * 64), 404)
        checks.append({"qualified_id": identity, "subject": subject, "sha256": item["sha256"], "bytes": len(raw),
            "pages": [item["start_page"], item["end_page"]], "frozen_payload_and_assets_bound": True, "private_pdf_http_sha_verified": True})
    return {"passed": True, "manifest_sha256": expected["manifest_sha256"], "records": len(manifest["items"]), "pdfs": len(files),
        "total_bytes": expected["total_bytes"], "samples": checks, "wrong_sha_and_revision_rejected": True, "model_calls": 0}


def run(frontend, core, native_expected=None):
    assert urlparse(frontend).hostname in {"127.0.0.1", "localhost", "::1"}
    pack = core / "deeptutor/services/student_learning/question_bank_data"
    manifest = json.loads((pack / "manifest.json").read_text())

        assert hashlib.file_digest(file, "sha256").hexdigest() == manifest["index_sha256"]

    def get(path, expected=200, raw=False, headers=False):
        assert path.startswith("/") and not path.startswith("//")
        try:
            with urlopen(urljoin(frontend, path), timeout=30) as response:
                assert urlparse(response.geturl()).hostname in {"127.0.0.1", "localhost", "::1"}
                assert response.status == expected
                body = response.read()
                result = body if raw else json.loads(body)
                return (result, response.headers) if headers else result
        except HTTPError as error:
            assert error.code == expected, (path, error.code, expected)

    catalog = get("/api/student/question-bank/catalog?limit=2")

    for subject in catalog["subjects"]:

    fts = get("/api/student/question-bank/questions?subject=physics&query=" + quote("浮力") + "&limit=2")
    assert fts["questions"] and fts["total"] > 0 and all(row["subject"] == "physics" for row in fts["questions"])
    nohit = get("/api/student/question-bank/questions?query=qaemptyfts9bd2e81a5dc74c22b2a8f75c6908c7b1&limit=2")

            if row is None:

                removed_exercise += int(bool(row[3]))
        assert len(excluded) == catalog["runtime_isolated_count"]
        assert catalog["effective_readable_count"] == manifest["question_count"] - removed_readable
        assert catalog["effective_exercise_candidate_count"] == manifest["exercise_candidate_count"] - removed_exercise
        for listed in [*first["questions"], *second["questions"], *fts["questions"]]:
            packed = json.loads(database.execute("SELECT d.body_json FROM questions q JOIN documents d ON d.payload_sha=q.payload_sha WHERE q.qualified_id=?", (listed["qualified_id"],)).fetchone()[0])
            assert type(listed["can_select_original"]) is bool and listed["can_select_original"] is packed["can_select_original"]

            detail = get(path)
            expected = json.loads(database.execute("SELECT d.body_json FROM questions q JOIN documents d ON d.payload_sha=q.payload_sha WHERE q.qualified_id=?", (identity,)).fetchone()[0])

        bindings = []

            assert row and hashlib.sha256(row[1].encode()).hexdigest() == row[0] == item["source_payload_sha256"]

"""Reuse completed Intel5 checks from the exact failed-run artifact."""
import hashlib,io,json,zipfile
from ci_picture_fresh import validate_native_page_views
REPO='1281504089-cell/kaixin-k12-tutor'
ARTIFACT={'id':14363427934,'bytes':9511640,'sha256':'f58d4be0ee58e8773783bb23b4bffb3ff801a42bd07848fac0d9a2bc1539a574','run_id':44146541944,'workflow_commit':'8a190f60c5043d7a3b334635d23def9351e60e7e','job_id':134263108457,'source_lock_sha256':'36d851b7865fbdbb86355764198351cb69c72647f4842e5fcd9ca1c7087cf0d9'}
ENTRIES={'oldest_launcher_entry':{'file':'oldest-update-entry.json','bytes':95767,'sha256':'694a7e8d525ff7c6a4d665d6ce65318d25d0512e8c95e5ca339b823c508c17f6'},'update_entry':{'file':'update-entry.json','bytes':96051,'sha256':'80a73595edbab1adc8ebf2831f6686430f4d993a274820697e1b5e6752a97395'}}
FRESH={'file':'picture-fresh-ui.json','bytes':32314,'sha256':'32ebe30703713498e8f80608fa2a6ae32645c0efa770062fa234cb894e98a801'}
def validate_partial_lock(lock):
 assert lock['target']=='macos-x64' and lock['candidate_tag']=='student-20261117-k12-5'
 assert lock['source_commit']=='9328240380d13ef75435434a8c901028ea4470dc'
 assert lock['resume_artifact']==ARTIFACT and lock['reused_complete_entries']==ENTRIES
 assert 'partial_native_evidence.py' in lock['recipe_inputs_sha256']
 if 'reused_fresh_picture_ui' in lock:
  assert lock['reused_fresh_picture_ui']==FRESH
  assert lock['recipe_inputs_sha256']['ci-picture-fresh.cjs']=='11889ea909eef882f9293a98b0e558d5c6fcef6e693cd0ef8a526797128eda72'

def validate_completed_entries(lock,files):
 validate_partial_lock(lock)
 old_raw=files['reuse-lock.json'];assert hashlib.sha256(old_raw).hexdigest()==ARTIFACT['source_lock_sha256']
 old=json.loads(old_raw)
 for key in ['target','candidate_tag','candidate_release_id','source_commit','included_manifest','prior_manifest','core_asset','bridge','frozen_stage','candidate_files','signed_runtime_assets','native_pages','bank_revision','picture_count','picture_manifest_sha256','runtime_exclusion_count','runtime_exclusion_kinds','runtime_exclusion_ledger_sha256']:
  assert old[key]==lock[key], 'Completed-entry source changed: '+key
 assert old['recipe_inputs_sha256']['ci-k12-library-ui.cjs']==lock['recipe_inputs_sha256']['ci-k12-library-ui.cjs']
 entries={}
 for key,row in ENTRIES.items():
  raw=files[row['file']];assert len(raw)==row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
  value=json.loads(raw);assert value['actual_download_install_backup_restart']=='passed' and value['check_again_current']
  assert all(value[k] is True for k in ['chat_preserved','task_preserved','saved_key_preserved'])
  assert value['from_runtime']==lock['prior_manifest']['runtimeId'] and value['to_launcher']=='20261117-updater-2'
  oldest=key=='oldest_launcher_entry'
  assert value['selected_archive']==(lock['bridge']['name'] if oldest else lock['core_asset']['name'])
  assert value['selected_base_runtime']==(None if oldest else lock['included_manifest']['baseRuntimeId'])
  expected='1.7.1-kaixin-20261117-k12-5-macos-x64-universal' if oldest else lock['included_manifest']['runtimeId']
  assert value['to_runtime']==expected
  if oldest:assert value['signed_launcher_restarted'] and value['old_pid']!=value['restarted_pid']
  else:assert value['download_progress_visible'] and value['downloaded_bytes_visible']
  ui=value['k12_library'];assert ui['passed'] and ui['actualNativeRenderer'] and ui['bank_revision']==lock['bank_revision']
  validate_native_page_views(ui,lock['native_pages']['ui_fixture'])
  for view in ui['views']:assert all(view['preparedPicture'][k] for k in ['native_http_image_sha_verified','body_dom_before_image_response','second_history_restore'])
  entries[key]=value
 return entries

def validate_completed_fresh(lock,files):
 validate_partial_lock(lock)
 assert lock['reused_fresh_picture_ui']==FRESH
 old_raw=files['reuse-lock.json'];assert hashlib.sha256(old_raw).hexdigest()==ARTIFACT['source_lock_sha256']
 old=json.loads(old_raw)
 for name in ['ci_picture_fresh.py','native-k12-fixture.py']:
  assert old['recipe_inputs_sha256'][name]==lock['recipe_inputs_sha256'][name]
 raw=files[FRESH['file']];assert len(raw)==FRESH['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==FRESH['sha256']
 value=json.loads(raw)
 assert value['passed'] and value['production_launcher_source_byte_identical'] and value['qa_code_only_in_disposable_copy']
 assert value['active_runtime_id']==lock['included_manifest']['runtimeId']
 assert value['k12_library']['diagnostic_entry']=='fresh' and value['k12_library']['model_calls']==0
 validate_native_page_views(value['k12_library'],lock['native_pages']['ui_fixture'])
 return value

def validate_partial_archive(lock,raw):
 validate_partial_lock(lock)
 assert len(raw)==ARTIFACT['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==ARTIFACT['sha256']
 reuse_fresh='reused_fresh_picture_ui' in lock
 required={'reuse-lock.json',*(v['file'] for v in ENTRIES.values())};files={}
 if reuse_fresh:required.add(FRESH['file'])
 with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as archive:
  prefixes=('k12-oldest-','k12-current-')+(('k12-fresh-','k12-library-fresh-') if reuse_fresh else ())
  selected=[i for i in archive.infolist() if i.filename in required or i.filename.startswith(prefixes) and i.filename.endswith(('.json','.png','.html'))]
  assert len({i.filename for i in selected})==len(selected)
  assert sum(i.file_size for i in selected)<64*1024**2
  for item in selected:
   assert '/' not in item.filename and '\\' not in item.filename and item.file_size<16*1024**2
   files[item.filename]=archive.read(item)
 assert required.issubset(files)
 result={'entries':validate_completed_entries(lock,files),'files':files}
 if reuse_fresh:result['fresh_picture_ui']=validate_completed_fresh(lock,files)
 return result

def fetch_partial_archive(lock,api,gh):
 validate_partial_lock(lock)
 meta=api('actions/artifacts/'+str(ARTIFACT['id']))
 assert meta['id']==ARTIFACT['id'] and meta['size_in_bytes']==ARTIFACT['bytes'] and meta['digest']=='sha256:'+ARTIFACT['sha256'] and not meta['expired']
 run=api('actions/runs/'+str(ARTIFACT['run_id']))
 assert run['status']=='completed' and run['conclusion']=='failure' and run['head_sha']==ARTIFACT['workflow_commit']
 jobs=api('actions/runs/'+str(ARTIFACT['run_id'])+'/jobs')['jobs']
 assert any(j['id']==ARTIFACT['job_id'] and j['conclusion']=='failure' for j in jobs)
 return validate_partial_archive(lock,gh('api','repos/'+REPO+'/actions/artifacts/'+str(ARTIFACT['id'])+'/zip'))

def write(file, value):

def main():

    parser.add_argument("--isolation-ledger", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    source, base = args.source.resolve(), args.baseline_source.resolve()
    ledger = json.loads(args.isolation_ledger.read_text())
    from release_source import safe_name
    excluded = {safe_name(row["file"]) for row in ledger["excluded_files"]}
    assert len(excluded) == len(ledger["excluded_files"])
    assert all(len(row["sha256"]) == 64 and row["bytes"] > 0 and row["reason"] for row in ledger["excluded_files"])
    for tree, commit in [(source, args.commit), (base, "896e79b517a008ac6d584526151862ff6191cf77")]:
        assert subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=tree).decode().strip() == commit
        changes = subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain", "-z", "--untracked-files=no"], cwd=tree).decode().rstrip("\0")
        assert not changes or (tree == source and all(change[3:] in excluded and change[:2].strip() == "D" for change in changes.split("\0"))), "Commit the tested source; only ledger-declared physical export deletions are permitted"
    assert args.tag.startswith(("student-20261116-", "student-20261117-")), "Only this owner's explicit release dates are permitted"

    marker_name = safe_name(ledger["isolation_marker"])

    assert marker.is_file() and not marker.is_symlink() and sha(marker) == ledger["isolation_marker_sha256"], "Copy the frozen isolation marker into the owner export"
    if marker_name not in {row["file"] for row in rows}:
        rows.append({"file": marker_name, "bytes": marker.stat().st_size, "sha256": sha(marker), "mode": marker.stat().st_mode & 0o777})
        rows.sort(key=lambda row: row["file"])
    previous = {row["file"]: row for row in base_rows}
    changed = [row for row in rows if row != previous.get(row["file"])]
    removed = sorted(set(previous) - {row["file"] for row in rows})
    write(root / "isolation-ledger.json", ledger)
    manifest = {"schema_version": 1, "scope": "published_export", "source_commit": args.commit, "isolation_ledger_sha256": sha(root / "isolation-ledger.json"), "excluded_files": sorted(excluded), "baseline_source_commit": "896e79b517a008ac6d584526151862ff6191cf77", "baseline_source_files_sha256": aggregate(base_rows), "files": rows, "changed": changed, "removed": removed}

"""One deterministic student-only payload used before and after source freeze."""
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tarfile
import time

from release_source import add_file, safe_name, sha

PREFIX = "core/deeptutor/services/student_learning/question_bank_data"
PART_BYTES = 512 * 1024


def prepare_bank_payload(bank, expected_manifest_sha, root):
    bank, root = Path(bank).resolve(), Path(root).resolve()
    assert sha(bank / "manifest.json") == expected_manifest_sha, "Wrong bank freeze"
    identity = json.loads((bank / "manifest.json").read_text())
    assert identity["teacher_evidence_included"] is False and identity["raw_snapshots_included"] is False
    assert (bank / "index.sqlite3").stat().st_size == identity["index_bytes"] and sha(bank / "index.sqlite3") == identity["index_sha256"]
    manifest_file = root / "bank-payload-manifest.json"
    state_file = root / "BANK-PAYLOAD-STATE.json"
    if manifest_file.exists() or state_file.exists():
        assert manifest_file.is_file() and state_file.is_file(), "Incomplete bank preparation; preserve this attempt"
        state = json.loads(state_file.read_text())
        assert state["bank_manifest_sha256"] == expected_manifest_sha and sha(manifest_file) == state["payload_manifest_sha256"]
        payload = json.loads(manifest_file.read_text())
        assert payload["bank_manifest"] == identity and payload["archive_prefix"] == PREFIX
        for row in payload["parts"]:
            file = root / safe_name(row["file"])
            assert file.stat().st_size == row["bytes"] and sha(file) == row["sha256"]
        return payload  # Reuse the same already-uploaded bytes; never regenerate them.
    assert not list(root.glob("bank-payload.0*")) and not (root / "bank-payload.tar.gz").exists(), "Preserve partial inputs"
    rows = []
    for file in sorted(bank.rglob("*")):
        if file.is_dir():
            assert not file.is_symlink()
            continue
        relative = file.relative_to(bank).as_posix()
        if relative == "isolation-report.json":
            continue  # Never read/copy isolated IDs or teacher evidence.
        assert file.is_file() and not file.is_symlink()
        assert relative in {"manifest.json", "index.sqlite3"} or relative.startswith("student-assets/")
        rows.append({"file": relative, "archive": PREFIX + "/" + relative, "bytes": file.stat().st_size, "sha256": sha(file)})
    assets = [row for row in rows if row["file"].startswith("student-assets/")]
    assert len(assets) == identity["asset_count"] and sum(row["bytes"] for row in assets) == identity["asset_bytes"]
    started = time.monotonic()
    archive = root / "bank-payload.tar.gz"
    with archive.open("xb") as raw, gzip.GzipFile(filename="", fileobj=raw, mode="wb", mtime=0) as zipped, tarfile.open(fileobj=zipped, mode="w|", format=tarfile.PAX_FORMAT) as package:
        for row in rows:
            with (bank / row["file"]).open("rb") as stream:
                add_file(package, row["archive"], stream, row["bytes"])
    parts = []
    with archive.open("rb") as stream:
        while block := stream.read(PART_BYTES):
            file = root / f"bank-payload.{len(parts) + 1:03d}"
            file.write_bytes(block)
            parts.append({"file": file.name, "bytes": len(block), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(block).hexdigest(), "git_blob_sha": hashlib.sha1(("blob " + str(len(block)) + "\0").encode() + block).hexdigest()})
    payload = {"schema_version": 1, "archive_prefix": PREFIX, "bank_manifest": identity, "private_isolation_receipt_sha256": identity["isolation_report_sha256"], "files": rows, "parts": parts, "archive_sha256": sha(archive)}
    manifest_file.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
    state = {"status": "bank-only-frozen", "source_pending": True, "source_prepared": False, "bank_manifest_sha256": expected_manifest_sha, "bank_revision": identity["bank_revision"], "payload_manifest_sha256": sha(manifest_file), "raw_bytes": sum(row["bytes"] for row in rows), "compressed_bytes": archive.stat().st_size, "archive_sha256": payload["archive_sha256"], "parts": len(parts), "part_bytes": PART_BYTES, "compression_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3), "teacher_or_isolation_report_included": False, "ref_or_ci_created": False}
    state_file.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2) + "\n")
    archive.unlink()
    return payload

import asyncio
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path


async def seed_science():
    home = Path(os.environ["DEEPTUTOR_HOME"])
    assert (home / ".science-fixture-allowed").is_file(), "Explicitly mark an isolated QA home first"
    from deeptutor.services.session import get_sqlite_session_store
    from deeptutor.co_writer.storage import get_co_writer_storage
    from deeptutor.services.student_learning import mistakes

    cases = json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name("science-cases.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert len(cases) == 12
    title = "物理化学等科公式显示合成验证"
    text = "# " + title + "\n\n| 类别 | 公式 |\n|---|---|\n"
    text += "\n".join("| " + name + " | " + (formula if name == "science-physical-units" else "$" + formula + "$") + " |" for name, formula in cases)
    store = get_sqlite_session_store()
    session = await store.create_session(title)
    await store.add_message(session["id"], "user", "以下为合成公式，仅验证显示，不生成学习结论。")
    await store.add_message(session["id"], "assistant", text, capability="chat")
    preview_session = await store.create_session("消息快速预览合成验证")
    preview = {"session": preview_session["id"], "titles": [], "answers": []}
    for number in range(1, 9):
        question = f"预览问题{number}：如何理解分数与单位一？"
        answer = f"预览回答{number}：先确定整体，再比较每份的大小。" + "请结合题目说明你选择这个单位的原因。" * 35
        await store.add_message(preview_session["id"], "user", question)
        await store.add_message(preview_session["id"], "assistant", answer, capability="chat")
        preview["titles"].append(question)
        preview["answers"].append(answer[:22])
    notes = get_co_writer_storage()
    note = notes.create_document(title=title, content=text)
    saved_cases = [cases[0], cases[4], cases[5], cases[-1]]
    saved = notes.create_document(title="已保存理化公式兼容", blocks=[{
        "id": "original-table", "type": "table", "props": {}, "content": {
            "type": "tableContent", "columnWidths": [160, 360], "rows": [
                {"cells": [[{"type": "text", "text": name, "styles": {}}], [{"type": "inlineMath", "props": {"formula": formula}}]]}
                for name, formula in saved_cases
            ]
        }, "children": []
    }])
    ids = {}
    for subject in ("physics", "chemistry"):
        selected = [(name, formula) for name, formula in cases if name.startswith(subject)]
        question = "\n\n".join(name + "：$" + formula + "$" for name, formula in selected)
        record = mistakes.create_record({"manual": True, "messages": [
            {"id": subject + "u", "role": "user", "content": question},
            {"id": subject + "w", "role": "user", "content": "$" + selected[0][1] + "$"}
        ]}, subject=subject, title=("物理" if subject == "physics" else "化学") + "公式合成记录")
        record.update(status="ready", analysis={
            "title": record["title"], "subject": subject,
            "question": {"messageId": subject + "u", "text": question},
            "studentWork": None, "verdict": "uncertain",
            "explanation": "合成显示样例：$" + selected[1][1] + "$",
            "correction": "保留原式：$" + selected[0][1] + "$",
            "examPoints": ["$" + selected[-1][1] + "$"],
            "uncertainties": [], "knowledgePoints": ["公式显示"]
        })
        mistakes._save(*mistakes.storage(), record)
        ids[subject] = record["id"]
    return {"preview": preview, "session": session["id"], "note": note.id, "saved_note": saved.id,
            "mistakes": ids, "cases": cases, "saved_cases": saved_cases}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--source", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--home", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    assert (args.home / ".science-fixture-allowed").is_file(), "Refusing an unmarked home"

import copy

from publication_transaction import PublicationIncomplete, publish_transaction


class FakeGitHub:
    def __init__(self, fault=None):
        self.releases = {
            'old': dict(id=1, name='old', body='old notes', prerelease=False, draft=False),
            'new': dict(id=2, name='candidate', body='candidate notes', prerelease=True, draft=False),
        }
        self.latest_id = 1
        self.ref = 'old-tag-object'
        self.assets = {('core-updates', 'a.json'): b'old a', ('core-updates', 'b.json'): b'old b'}
        self.fault = fault or {}
        self.calls = []

    def release(self, tag):
        return copy.deepcopy(self.releases[tag])

    def latest(self):
        return copy.deepcopy(next(r for r in self.releases.values() if r['id'] == self.latest_id))

    def tag_sha(self, tag):
        return self.ref

    def asset_bytes(self, tag, name):
        return self.assets.get((tag, name))

    def mutate(self, label, write, delete=None):
        self.calls.append(label)
        mode = self.fault.pop(label, None)
        if mode == 'before':
            raise TimeoutError(label)
        if mode == 'deleted':
            delete()
            raise TimeoutError(label)
        write()
        if mode == 'after':
            raise TimeoutError(label)

    def upload_bytes(self, tag, name, raw):
        label = 'upload:' + name + ':' + ('old' if raw.startswith(b'old') else 'new')
        def write():
            self.assets[tag, name] = raw
            if self.fault.pop(label + ':corrupt', False):
                self.assets[tag, name] = b'corrupt readback'
        self.mutate(label, write, lambda: self.assets.pop((tag, name), None))

    def delete_asset(self, tag, name):
        self.mutate('delete:' + name, lambda: self.assets.pop((tag, name), None))

    def set_tag(self, tag, commit):
        self.mutate('tag:' + commit, lambda: setattr(self, 'ref', commit))

    def edit_release(self, release_id, fields, latest):
        def write():
            row = next(r for r in self.releases.values() if r['id'] == release_id)
            row.update(fields)
            if latest:
                self.latest_id = release_id
        self.mutate('latest:' + str(release_id) + ':' + str(fields['prerelease']), write)


class PublicationTransactionTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_case(self, backend):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        root = Path(self.temp.name)
        try:
            result = publish_transaction(
                backend, tag='new', commit='new-publication',
                pointers={'a.json': b'new a', 'b.json': b'new b'},
                previous={'a.json': b'old a', 'b.json': b'old b'},
                installation=b'new instructions', receipt_file=root / 'receipt.json',
                receipt_factory=lambda release: {'release_id': release['id'], 'published': True},
                journal_file=root / 'journal.json', title='new title', notes='new notes', expected_latest_id=1)
            error = None
        except PublicationIncomplete as caught:
            result, error = None, caught
        return result, error, json.loads((root / 'journal.json').read_text())

    def assert_old(self, backend):
        self.assertEqual(backend.assets['core-updates', 'a.json'], b'old a')
        self.assertEqual(backend.assets['core-updates', 'b.json'], b'old b')
        self.assertEqual(backend.ref, 'old-tag-object')
        self.assertEqual(backend.latest_id, 1)
        self.assertTrue(backend.releases['new']['prerelease'])

    def test_deleted_asset_failure_restores_every_attempted_pointer(self):
        backend = FakeGitHub({'upload:b.json:new': 'deleted'})
        _, error, journal = self.run_case(backend)
        self.assertIsNotNone(error)
        self.assert_old(backend)
        self.assertEqual(journal['status'], 'failed_and_previous_state_verified')
        self.assertEqual(len(journal['attempted']), 2)

    def test_clobber_response_loss_is_read_back_without_repeating_write(self):
        backend = FakeGitHub({'upload:a.json:new': 'after'})
        result, error, journal = self.run_case(backend)
        self.assertIsNone(error)
        self.assertTrue(result['published'])
        self.assertEqual(backend.calls.count('upload:a.json:new'), 1)
        self.assertEqual(journal['status'], 'published_and_receipt_verified')

    def test_tag_and_latest_response_loss_are_not_retried(self):
        backend = FakeGitHub({'tag:new-publication': 'after', 'latest:2:False': 'after'})
        _, error, _ = self.run_case(backend)
        self.assertIsNone(error)
        self.assertEqual(backend.calls.count('tag:new-publication'), 1)
        self.assertEqual(backend.calls.count('latest:2:False'), 1)

    def test_real_tag_failure_restores_defaults_and_installation(self):
        backend = FakeGitHub({'tag:new-publication': 'before'})
        _, error, journal = self.run_case(backend)
        self.assertIsNotNone(error)
        self.assert_old(backend)
        self.assertNotIn(('new', 'INSTALLATION.txt'), backend.assets)
        self.assertEqual(journal['status'], 'failed_and_previous_state_verified')

    def test_real_latest_failure_restores_tag_and_all_defaults(self):
        backend = FakeGitHub({'latest:2:False': 'before'})
        _, error, journal = self.run_case(backend)
        self.assertIsNotNone(error)
        self.assert_old(backend)
        self.assertEqual(journal['status'], 'failed_and_previous_state_verified')

    def test_receipt_failure_does_not_republish_or_undo_consistent_latest(self):
        backend = FakeGitHub({'upload:PUBLICATION-RECEIPT.json:new': 'before'})
        _, error, journal = self.run_case(backend)
        self.assertIsNotNone(error)
        self.assertEqual(journal['status'], 'published_but_receipt_incomplete')
        self.assertEqual(backend.latest_id, 2)
        self.assertEqual(backend.ref, 'new-publication')
        self.assertEqual(backend.calls.count('latest:2:False'), 1)
        self.assertEqual(journal['recovery'], [])

    def test_receipt_response_loss_confirms_success(self):
        backend = FakeGitHub({'upload:PUBLICATION-RECEIPT.json:new': 'after'})
        _, error, journal = self.run_case(backend)
        self.assertIsNone(error)
        self.assertEqual(journal['status'], 'published_and_receipt_verified')

    def test_rollback_response_loss_is_confirmed_from_old_bytes(self):
        backend = FakeGitHub({'latest:2:False': 'before', 'upload:a.json:old': 'after'})
        _, error, journal = self.run_case(backend)
        self.assertIsNotNone(error)
        self.assert_old(backend)
        self.assertEqual(journal['status'], 'failed_and_previous_state_verified')

    def test_wrong_rollback_readback_stays_owner_action_required(self):
        backend = FakeGitHub({'latest:2:False': 'before', 'upload:a.json:old:corrupt': True})
        _, error, journal = self.run_case(backend)
        self.assertIsNotNone(error)
        self.assertEqual(journal['status'], 'failed_recovery_requires_owner_readback')
        self.assertTrue(any(r.get('restored_and_read_back') is False for r in journal['recovery']))
        self.assertEqual(backend.calls.count('upload:a.json:old'), 1)

    def test_unknown_rollback_get_does_not_blindly_overwrite(self):
        backend = FakeGitHub({'latest:2:False': 'before'})
        read = backend.asset_bytes
        def unavailable(tag, name):
            if name == 'a.json' and 'latest:2:False' in backend.calls:
                raise TimeoutError('readback unavailable')
            return read(tag, name)
        backend.asset_bytes = unavailable
        _, error, journal = self.run_case(backend)
        self.assertIsNotNone(error)
        self.assertEqual(journal['status'], 'failed_recovery_requires_owner_readback')
        self.assertNotIn('upload:a.json:old', backend.calls)

    def test_workflow_first_step_only_writes_local_marker_and_exact_gate(self):
        source = Path(__file__).with_name('.github') / 'workflows' / 'attachment-publish.yml'
        text = source.read_text()
        first = text.split('- name: Record publication run', 1)[1].split('- name:', 1)[0]
        self.assertIn('b.get("prepared") is True', first)
        self.assertIn('b["tag"]=="student-20261117-k12-7"', first)
        self.assertNotIn('gh release', first)
        self.assertNotIn('codex/k12-publish-20261116', text)

    def test_changed_latest_after_early_checks_causes_zero_writes(self):
        backend = FakeGitHub()
        backend.latest_id = 2
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError, 'Latest changed'):
            self.run_case(backend)
        self.assertEqual(backend.calls, [])

    def test_candidate_already_published_causes_zero_writes(self):
        backend = FakeGitHub()
        backend.releases['new']['prerelease'] = False
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError, 'no longer'):
            self.run_case(backend)
        self.assertEqual(backend.calls, [])

"""Tiny synthetic bank bytes only; no teacher/originals, model or network."""
import hashlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tarfile
import tempfile
import unittest

from release_bank import PREFIX, prepare_bank_payload
from release_source import sha


class ReleaseBankTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.bank, self.out = self.root / "bank", self.root / "recipe"
        (self.bank / "student-assets").mkdir(parents=True)
        self.out.mkdir()
        (self.bank / "index.sqlite3").write_bytes(b"tiny synthetic index")
        (self.bank / "student-assets/a.png").write_bytes(b"tiny synthetic image")
        (self.bank / "isolation-report.json").write_text("PRIVATE-SYNTHETIC-ISOLATED-IDS")
        manifest = {"schema_version": 1, "bank_revision": "b" * 64, "teacher_evidence_included": False, "raw_snapshots_included": False,
                    "index_bytes": 20, "index_sha256": sha(self.bank / "index.sqlite3"), "asset_count": 1, "asset_bytes": 20,
                    "isolation_report_sha256": sha(self.bank / "isolation-report.json")}
        (self.bank / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
        self.freeze = sha(self.bank / "manifest.json")

    def tearDown(self):
        self.temp.cleanup()

    def test_same_shared_function_reuses_identical_parts_and_excludes_isolated_ids(self):
        first = prepare_bank_payload(self.bank, self.freeze, self.out)
        raw = b"".join((self.out / row["file"]).read_bytes() for row in first["parts"])
        with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw)) as package:
            names = package.getnames()
            self.assertEqual(set(names), {PREFIX + "/manifest.json", PREFIX + "/index.sqlite3", PREFIX + "/student-assets/a.png"})
            self.assertNotIn(b"PRIVATE-SYNTHETIC", b"".join(package.extractfile(item).read() for item in package))
        second = prepare_bank_payload(self.bank, self.freeze, self.out)
        self.assertEqual(first, second)
        state = json.loads((self.out / "BANK-PAYLOAD-STATE.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual(state["status"], "bank-only-frozen")
        self.assertTrue(state["source_pending"])
        self.assertFalse(state["source_prepared"])

    def test_reuse_rejects_changed_transport_bytes(self):
        first = prepare_bank_payload(self.bank, self.freeze, self.out)
        with (self.out / first["parts"][0]["file"]).open("ab") as file:
            file.write(b"changed")
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            prepare_bank_payload(self.bank, self.freeze, self.out)

    def test_new_freeze_cannot_silently_overwrite_existing_parts(self):
        prepare_bank_payload(self.bank, self.freeze, self.out)
        data = json.loads((self.bank / "manifest.json").read_text());data["bank_revision"] = "c" * 64
        (self.bank / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(data))
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            prepare_bank_payload(self.bank, sha(self.bank / "manifest.json"), self.out)

    def test_unapproved_teacher_file_is_rejected(self):
        (self.bank / "teacher.txt").write_text("synthetic forbidden teacher evidence")
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            prepare_bank_payload(self.bank, self.freeze, self.out)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Offline hostile-input checks; no product import, model, network or signing key."""
import gzip
import hashlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tarfile
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

from release_source import add_file, aggregate, apply_overlay, inventory, runtime_rows, safe_name, sha, join_source_overlay, stage_frozen_files


class ReleaseSourceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.source = self.root / "student-source"
        self.source.mkdir()
        subprocess.run(["git", "init", "--quiet"], cwd=self.source, check=True)
        (self.source / "keep.py").write_text("published\n")
        (self.source / "remove.py").write_text("obsolete\n")
        subprocess.run(["git", "add", "."], cwd=self.source, check=True)
        self.base = inventory(self.source)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.temp.cleanup()

    def overlay(self, entries=None):
        content = b"new frozen bytes\n"
        row = {"file": "keep.py", "bytes": len(content), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(), "mode": 0o644}
        archive = self.root / "source-overlay.001"
        with archive.open("wb") as raw, gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=raw, mode="wb", mtime=0) as zipped, tarfile.open(fileobj=zipped, mode="w|") as package:
            for name in entries or ["keep.py"]:
                add_file(package, name, io.BytesIO(content), len(content))
        manifest = {"source_commit": "f" * 40, "baseline_source_files_sha256": aggregate(self.base), "files": [row], "changed": [row], "removed": ["remove.py"]}
        file = self.root / "inventory.json"
        file.write_text(json.dumps(manifest))
        return {"manifest": file.name, "manifest_sha256": sha(file), "parts": [{"file": archive.name, "bytes": archive.stat().st_size, "sha256": sha(archive)}], "archive_sha256": sha(archive), "source_files_sha256": aggregate([row])}

    def test_source_overlay_roundtrip_preserves_exact_hash_and_removes_deleted(self):
        descriptor = self.overlay()
        result = apply_overlay(self.root, self.source, descriptor)
        self.assertEqual(result["source_commit"], "f" * 40)
        self.assertEqual((self.source / "keep.py").read_text(), "new frozen bytes\n")
        self.assertFalse((self.source / "remove.py").exists())

    def test_changed_published_parent_rejected_before_overlay(self):
        descriptor = self.overlay()
        (self.source / "keep.py").write_text("not published\n")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "parent differs"):
            apply_overlay(self.root, self.source, descriptor)
        self.assertTrue((self.source / "remove.py").exists())

    def test_tampered_overlay_part_rejected(self):
        descriptor = self.overlay()
        with (self.root / "source-overlay.001").open("ab") as file:
            file.write(b"tamper")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "part checksum"):
            apply_overlay(self.root, self.source, descriptor)

    def test_duplicate_overlay_member_rejected(self):
        descriptor = self.overlay(["keep.py", "keep.py"])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Unexpected source overlay"):
            apply_overlay(self.root, self.source, descriptor)

    def test_unlisted_overlay_member_rejected(self):
        descriptor = self.overlay(["outside.py"])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Unexpected source overlay"):
            apply_overlay(self.root, self.source, descriptor)

    def test_symlink_source_rejected(self):
        descriptor = self.overlay()
        (self.source / "keep.py").unlink()
        (self.source / "keep.py").symlink_to(self.root / "private")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "regular frozen"):
            apply_overlay(self.root, self.source, descriptor)

    def test_paths_reject_traversal_hidden_state_and_private_key(self):
        for name in ["../outside", "/outside", "x\\file", "C:/file", "x/.git/config", "data/user/settings.json", "signing-private.pem", "x//file"]:
            with self.subTest(name=name), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                safe_name(name)

    def test_runtime_inventory_carries_new_package_data_and_cjs(self):
        names = ["deeptutor/new.py", "deeptutor/services/student_learning/reference.cjs", "deeptutor/services/student_learning/textbook-models/model.onnx", "deeptutor/services/student_learning/textbook-defaults/reference.sqlite3", "scripts/new.py", "assets/brand/logo.png", "assets/figs/system/diagram.png", "tests/test_new.py", "web/app/page.tsx"]
        selected = {row["file"] for row in runtime_rows([{"file": name} for name in names])}
        self.assertEqual(selected, set(names[:6]))

    def test_staging_keeps_ignored_frozen_pdfs_and_excludes_unlisted_files(self):
        rows = list(self.base)
        for name, data in [(".gitignore", b"*.pdf\n"), *[(f"native/{i}.pdf", b"%PDF-fixture") for i in range(101)]]:
            file = self.source / name
            file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            file.write_bytes(data)
            rows.append({"file": name, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": sha(file)})
        (self.source / "unlisted.txt").write_text("must stay outside the freeze")
        (self.source / "unlisted.pdf").write_bytes(b"not frozen")
        stage_frozen_files(self.source, rows)
        self.assertEqual(aggregate(inventory(self.source)), aggregate(rows))
        names = {row["file"] for row in inventory(self.source)}
        self.assertNotIn("unlisted.txt", names)
        self.assertNotIn("unlisted.pdf", names)
        self.assertIn("native/100.pdf", names)

    def test_main_rebuild_can_use_hash_bound_release_asset_without_git_parts(self):
        descriptor = self.overlay()
        file = self.root / "source-overlay.001"
        data = file.read_bytes();file.unlink()
        descriptor["remote_archive"] = {"url": "https://github.com/1281504089-cell/kaixin-k12-tutor/releases/download/student-20261117-k12-1/source-overlay.tar.gz", "bytes": len(data), "sha256": descriptor["archive_sha256"]}
        class Response(io.BytesIO):
            def geturl(self):
                return "https://release-assets.githubusercontent.com/frozen-source"
        with patch("release_source.urlopen", return_value=Response(data)):
            apply_overlay(self.root, self.source, descriptor)
        self.assertEqual((self.source / "keep.py").read_bytes(), b"new frozen bytes\n")

    def test_native_pages_source_asset_fits_bounded_remote_rebuild(self):
        descriptor = self.overlay()
        (self.root / "source-overlay.001").unlink()
        descriptor["remote_archive"] = {"url": "https://github.com/1281504089-cell/kaixin-k12-tutor/releases/download/student-20261117-k12-5/source-overlay.tar.gz", "bytes": 296762769, "sha256": descriptor["archive_sha256"]}
        with patch("release_source.urlopen", side_effect=RuntimeError("trusted request reached")) as request:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "trusted request reached"):
                join_source_overlay(self.root, self.root / "allowed.tar.gz", descriptor)
            request.assert_called_once()
        descriptor["remote_archive"]["bytes"] = 512 * 1024 * 1024 + 1
        with patch("release_source.urlopen", side_effect=AssertionError("No oversized request")) as request:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Untrusted source overlay"):
                join_source_overlay(self.root, self.root / "oversized.tar.gz", descriptor)
            request.assert_not_called()

    def test_release_asset_fallback_rejects_another_host_before_request(self):
        descriptor = self.overlay()
        file = self.root / "source-overlay.001"
        size = file.stat().st_size;file.unlink()
        descriptor["remote_archive"] = {"url": "https://example.com/source-overlay.tar.gz", "bytes": size, "sha256": descriptor["archive_sha256"]}
        with patch("release_source.urlopen", side_effect=AssertionError("No untrusted network")), self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Untrusted source overlay"):
            apply_overlay(self.root, self.source, descriptor)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
